   130	## 5. Operational Contracts
   131	
   132	### 5.1 Initialisation Contract
   133	- **Preconditions:** VIO and BAT must be stable; VIO must be powered before IO pins are driven by the host.
   134	- **Guarantees:** Asserts SPI_RDY (if in SPI mode) after internal reset; ready to translate host wake-up command.
   135	
   136	### 5.2 Steady-State Contract
   137	- **Guarantees:** Bi-directional translation of UART/SPI frames to Daisy Chain protocol.
   138	- **Accuracy:** Bit-perfect data translation; supports robust comms in high-noise environments.
   139	
   140	### 5.3 Fault Contract
   141	- **Conditions:** Unmasked fault detected in daisy chain or internal IC error.
   142	- **Action:** Asserts NFAULT active low; can trigger system-wide wake-up via INH if configured.
